{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check that the fix worked
print('Sample of cleaned revenue:')
print(df['revenue_clean'].head())

# Verify no QA orders with 999999.99 (though we saw 0 earlier)
qa_count_clean = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f'QA orders after cleaning: {qa_count_clean}')"}
